title: Woolworths Limited - proposed acquisition of Officeworks and Target
industries: Office products, discount department store retail
targets:
Officeworks BusinessDirect Pty Ltd
Officeworks Superstores Pty Ltd
Target Australia Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commences review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines. Market inquiries commenced.
Timeline delayed by negotiations on confidentiality restrictions.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
Decision date amended from 'early September' to 'September' to allow for provision of further information by Woolworths and consideration of submissions from market participants.
ACCC published a Statement of Issues outlining preliminary competition concerns. Proposed date for announcement of ACCC's findings amended accordingly.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
Decision date amended from 3 October to 17 October 2007 due to Woolworths' delay in providing a submission in response to the Statement of Issues.
Decision date amended to early November to allow for further investigation, including examination of conglomerate effects.
Woolworths withdrew its application for ACCC clearance.
